title: Resolved UV and [C II] Structures of Luminous Galaxies within the Epoch of Reionization
question: What causes the differences in Lyα EW between two luminous z=6.5 LAEs (VR7, MASOSA): differences in SFR, dust content, age, metallicity; and are luminous LAEs multi-component systems?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 6 µJy/beam; 0.08-0.10 mJy/beam in 18 km/s channels (natural weighting)

what.value: Compilation of z≈6-7 galaxies with ALMA [CII], UV and IR measurements

evidence.quote: we compile a sample of spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at $z\approx6-7$ for which the \[Cii\] line and adjacent continuum has been observed with ALMA

external_data.citation: Ota2014; Inoue2016; Matthee2017ALMA; Carniani2018; Pentericci2016; Smit2017 and others

evidence.quote: Our results are compared to relations between \[Cii\] luminosity and SFR based on observations of galaxies in the local Universe (cite: DeLooze2014).

recipe.method: CASA clean with natural weighting + 650 kλ taper for detectability; Briggs robust 0.5 for resolved analysis

recipe.goal: HST photometry, UV slope and sizes
recipe.method: 1.2'' aperture photometry in F110W/F160W with Lyα correction; imfit exponential profile fits on F160W

recipe.goal: Continuum limits and IR luminosity/obscured SFR
recipe.method: 1σ limits from tapered continuum; optically thin greybody 8-1000 µm, CMB-corrected, Kennicutt SFR_IR

recipe.goal: Integrated [CII] properties of VR7 and MASOSA limit
recipe.method: Bootstrap (1000 perturbations) of 1D spectrum for z and FWHM; CASA imfit elliptical Gaussian on collapsed PB-corrected cube; MASOSA limit from rms and fake-source injection (500 positions)
key_parameters: VR7 collapse 252.285-252.519 GHz (-20 to -320 km/s wrt Lyα)
assumptions: MASOSA conservative limit assumes 200 km/s width and ~0.7'' beam

recipe.goal: Resolved [CII] morphology, moments, PV, resolved UV/[CII] ratio
recipe.method: High-res Briggs cube; moment maps 0-3; PV diagrams with CASA impv, 1.5'' slit; SFR_UV/SFR_[CII] maps using Kennicutt and De Looze

recipe.goal: Place on [CII]-SFR relation and infer metallicity
recipe.method: Compile and homogenise literature sample; compare with De Looze relation; Vallini2015 for metallicity

evidence.quote: This results in a total flux of $447\pm42$ mJy km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Number of clean iterations, threshold, masks and cell/image size
Flux calibration uncertainty and any self-calibration
Exact spectrum extraction aperture for 1D spectra
Fitting procedure/priors for two-component Gaussian and imfit uncertainties
Number of UV-tapered/channel parameters for PV and moment map cuts
Rest frequency used for [CII] and moment-map thresholds
missing_for_reproduction: Clean parameters (masks, thresholds, image size, cell)
Compilation reductions tables partly rely on literature values
score_reason: Data and main recipe clear with CASA version and weighting, but many imaging and extraction details missing and several analysis steps inherited.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data are archival-accessible (2017.1.01451.S, ALMA data likely public by now) and main results (fluxes, limits) are numeric, though some details are unstated.
